uses.text: Droperidol (Inapsine, Droleptan, Dridol, Xomolix, Innovar [combination with fentanyl]) is an antidopaminergic drug used as an antiemetic (that is, to prevent or treat nausea) and as an antipsychotic. Droperidol is also often used as a rapid sedative in intensive-care treatment, and where "agitation aggression or violent behavior" are present.

sideEffects.text: Dysphoria, sedation, hypotension resulting from peripheral alpha adrenoceptor blockade, prolongation of QT interval which can lead to torsades de pointes, and extrapyramidal side effects such as dystonic reactions/neuroleptic malignant syndrome.

summaryZh: 氟哌利多是一種抗多巴胺能藥物，具止吐劑與抗精神病藥作用。市場上有單方，也有與芬太尼組成的複方藥物。臨床上常用於急性鎮靜，特別是在重症照護時，當患者出現激動、攻擊性或暴力行為時。
